stories.headline: Saudi Arabia, Turkey and Pakistan convene Mecca defence pact committee in Riyadh
stories.summary: The strategic political and defence committee of the Mecca defence pact is due to meet in Riyadh on October 5 to discuss regional developments, institutionalisation of the alliance and political engagement with Yemen's Houthis.
stories.why_it_matters: The meeting is a major test of the trilateral security framework and Pakistan's role in regional diplomacy.

sources.title: Turkey says Mecca pact committee to meet in Riyadh on October 5

stories.headline: Middle East crude exports rise above pre-war levels despite Strait of Hormuz attacks
stories.summary: Kpler shipping data cited by Reuters showed Middle East crude exports exceeded pre-war levels on four days in the final week of September, while maritime attacks around the Strait of Hormuz increased.
stories.why_it_matters: The Strait of Hormuz remains a critical chokepoint for global crude and LNG supply, making shipping security central to energy prices and inflation.

quick_gk.label: Seven-day moving average of crude exports on October 1

sources.title: Middle East crude oil exports exceed pre-war levels but tanker attacks increase

stories.headline: IMF and Sri Lanka reach staff-level agreement on seventh EFF review
stories.summary: The IMF reached a staff-level agreement with Sri Lanka on the seventh review under its Extended Fund Facility, potentially unlocking about $345 million in financing.
stories.why_it_matters: The agreement is a significant milestone in Sri Lanka's post-crisis economic reform programme.

sources.title: IMF, Sri Lanka strike staff-level pact on funding of $345 million
